headline: First forecast for minimum wage is in: Economist Mahmut Aydoğmuş gives a figure for 2027! - Sözcü Newspaper
summary: Economist Mahmut Aydoğmuş forecast a 2027 minimum wage of 37,000 lira ahead of talks in December. He also pointed to a further risk in the report.
why: The minimum wage sets a wage floor for millions of workers and influences inflation expectations and labour costs in Türkiye.
